I will keep this bean plot mostly low-cost because my land is small and I cannot spend much on purchased inputs. For beans, I would rather use some manure if I can get it, plant the seed I normally keep or buy locally, and depend on family work. I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use chemicals on this plot unless there is a serious problem.
